front: Wire-rim glasses that boost Diplomacy and help you recall the names of people you've met.
back:
+1 item bonus to Diplomacy.
Activate - Have We Met? (1 action, concentrate): stare at a creature and instantly remember its name if you've met and exchanged names. Relies on your memories, so it doesn't see through disguises (you'd get the name of the person they're impersonating).
